messages.subject: Update 0.1.3 for qcaERT is now available on CRAN
messages.subject_clean: Update 0.1.3 for qcaERT is now available on CRAN
messages.body_plain:
Hey y'all!

Version 0.1.3 of qcaERT is now available on CRAN: cran.r-project.org/package=qcaERT <http://cran.r-project.org/package=qcaERT>

For those who don't know, qcaERT (Qualitative Comparative Analysis Enhanced Robustness Tests) is an R package for thoroughly assessing the robustness of solutions in QCA, helping researchers examine how their solutions respond to changes in calibration thresholds, truth-table cutoffs, or the cases included in the analysis. The open-access book covers and teaches all the features in detail: marisguia.github.io/qcaERT/ <http://marisguia.github.io/qcaERT/>

What's new in 0.1.3:

- Changed how the leave-one-out and subsampling diagnostics report consistency, PRI, and coverage when QCA returns multiple models.
- The subsampling diagnostic now distinguishes confirmed baseline matches from incomplete comparisons.
- Updates to stratified sampling, frequency-cutoff draws, outcome negation, calibration and inclusion-cutoff searches.
- Fixed a bug in the solution charts.

Comments, corrections, and suggestions are very welcome!

Best,
Breno
